title: auto-comfy-draw config
description: Parameter contract for pipeline.py / pipeline_twopass.py config files.

model.description: Checkpoint filename; must be one of the names reported by --discover.

lora_strength.description: LoRA strength; lower (0.4-0.6) for reference-image work.

start_cmd.description: Command to launch ComfyUI; used by --start after user consent.

server_out.description: Server output ROOT; enables direct-write mode (script only reads it).

server_output_dir.description: Alias of server_out for config-driven direct mode.

server_sub.description: Subfolder under the server output root.

output_dir.description: Download-mode output directory (must be writable by the script; not needed in direct mode).

prefix.description: Filename prefix / subfolder for saved images.
